summary: Season data-file setup chain: initializes a session structure on the stack, writes the vehicle setup file for the current track name (dword_7CE668) or the default directory (byte_5EA438) when no track is selected, triggers the auto-load config file processing at byte_7CE498, deallocates the score-slot array, and frees a stack scratch buffer if non-null.

operations.description: SessionStructInit(v2) initializes a session structure on the stack before the setup chain proceeds.
The setup path is taken from dword_7CE668 (current track name); when null it falls back to the default application directory byte_5EA438.
VehicleSetupFileWriter(v2, path, 0) writes the vehicle setup file for the resolved track path using the initialized session structure.
sub_4B0770(byte_7CE498, 1) triggers processing of the auto-load config file referenced by byte_7CE498 with parameter 1.
ScoreSlotDeallocator(v4) deallocates the score-slot array built on the stack.
If the stack scratch pointer v3 is non-null it is freed through FreeWrapper_7bcf, otherwise null is returned.
Returns null when no scratch pointer was pending; otherwise returns after freeing it.

unresolved: The stack slot v3 is read before any write in the decompiled body; it is an uninitialized-scratch artifact whose source-level meaning (owned heap pointer vs leftover stack garbage) is unclear.
callee __alloca_probe is the compiler-emitted stack probe for the large frame; its presence carries no call-site semantics.
